title: Congestion health-ring radius sized for ~1.5-tile buildings is smaller than the new 2.20-tile campus footprint for most of the pulse cycle
detail: Ring radius spans 0.884–1.14 tiles (base 0.95 × 0.92–1.20 via PULSE16), but campus half-width is 1.10 tiles; for 11 of 16 pulse entries the ring lies inside the campus silhouette, slicing through the sprite instead of encircling it. Ring is drawn on top so it stays visible (E9.1 holds via glyph/pulse), but the 'ring clears the sprite' contract is broken for campus.
recommended_fix: Scale draw_health_ring's base radius by the node's role footprint (e.g. base = s * max(0.95, footprint_half + margin) for Campus/small_biz), or bump the base for 2.20-tile campuses, then re-bless affected T2 goldens.
